method: Blender SURFACE_DEFORM -- the low-res rigged cage drives the full-resolution render mesh. Native modifier, no hand-written geometry (OWNER LAW #3). The cage is unchanged, so every landmark and measurement already banked against it still holds.

bindCage.name: MARS_CAGE_BIND
bindCage.why: Surface Deform refuses a target with edges on more than two polygons AND a target with concave n-gons. Splitting fixes the first, triangulating the second; neither moves a vertex. Done on a COPY so MARS_MESH stays byte-identical.
